probes.question: True or false: Marie Curie's notebooks are expected to remain radioactive for well over a thousand years.
Radium-226 has a half-life of about how many years?

image.alt: Marie Curie in profile, seated at a laboratory bench with scientific apparatus, in an early black-and-white photograph

body.claim: Marie Curie's notebooks are expected to remain radioactive for well over a thousand years.
body.why: Radium-226 has a half-life of about 1,600 years. Curie's remains and those of Pierre Curie were sealed in a lead lining because of the radioactivity.
